thread:
maya: Heads up — running into a funky Bun + Deno interplay while validating our JS SDK sample app. Works in node, but Bun fails to resolve CJS fallback from exports.

maya: Error: “Cannot find module './dist/index.cjs'” even though dist contains both mjs and cjs.

sam: Bun's resolver will sometimes only honor the import field in package.json exports. If require is present but not referenced, Bun can ignore it.

maya: tried `import { createClient } from 'redwood-sdk'` and `const pkg = await import('redwood-sdk')` — hit the same path resolution problem.

jin: can you show the package.json exports block shipped with the sample? that usually explains this class of failures.

maya: our current snippet is:

```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" },
  "./runtime": "./dist/runtime.mjs"
}
```

maya: Bun appears to prefer import and then do file resolution which ends up looking for nested cjs path that isn't reachable.

alex: simplest UX fix: expose an explicit entry like `redwood-sdk/cjs` pointing to the CJS bundle so runtimes that prefer file paths can import it. avoid relying solely on dual exports.

sam: second problem — Deno errors on `node:crypto` imports. our small util imports `node:crypto` to get subtle, so Deno complains “Import "node:crypto" could not be resolved”.

jin: runtime shim pattern helps: prefer globalThis.crypto.subtle first, then dynamically import `node:crypto` only for node. e.g.:

```
const subtle = globalThis?.crypto?.subtle ?? (await import('node:crypto')).webcrypto.subtle;
```

jin: that keeps edge/deno happy and keeps node working. add tests to assert subtle digest shape.

maya: another weirdness with Bun's fetch: on 307/308 redirects Bun drops Authorization when replaying the request, so our automatic retry ends up unauthenticated. node-fetch preserved it.

alex: we should explicitly carry Authorization when re-issuing retries, but gated by same-origin checks to avoid leaking credentials across domains. add a config toggle for permissive vs strict behavior.

sam: typing mismatch: our exported types extend global Response/Request which diverge between node/deno. Deno's lib types are narrower and TS errors crop up in consumer apps.

jin: easiest path is to define a tiny portable interface (status, ok, json(), text(), headers) and map the runtime Response into that interface in the client. avoids depending on ambient DOM types.

maya: onboarding friction — quickstart sample uses `npm i redwood-sdk` and assumes node toolchain. Bun users running `bun install` hit the esm path and break because a small helper still does `require('fs')`.

sam: move node-only helpers behind dynamic import guarded by environment checks (`if (isNode) await import('./node-helpers-node-only.js')`). keep ESM entry fully clean.

alex: proposed actionable checklist for the PRs: 
- add explicit `./cjs` export entry in package.json so Bun can import CJS bundle
- use globalThis.crypto.subtle fallback before node:crypto and lazy-import node polyfills
- copy Authorization header during retry when safe (same-origin or allowed)
- export minimal runtime types instead of extending ambient DOM types
- add CI smoke suites running Bun and Deno to catch regressions

maya: i'll draft the PR including package.json change and webcrypto fallback. who wants to pick up CI?

sam: i'll add a Bun smoke job; will make an action that runs `bun` to import the sample app and call createClient->healthCheck.

jin: i'll add Deno CI and the types shim + mapping layer.

alex: i'll handle the retry header copy + origin whitelist and a small unit test for redirect behavior.

deploy-bot: maya created branch `dev/platform/deno-bun-interop` (https://git.internal/r/redwood/+/dev/platform/deno-bun-interop) :rocket: :eyes:

mica: tiny doc ask — can we add a note in quickstart README mentioning Bun/Deno caveats (bun install vs npm install, deno import flags, and `--unstable` notes)? will save a bunch of support time.

maya: yup I'll add a devex section in the quickstart that lists commands for bun/deno and the recommended CI checks. will ping when PR is up. thanks all :wave:
